summary: Sibanye Stillwater Ltd filed a Form 6-K, a report of a foreign private issuer pursuant to Rule 13a-16 or 15d-16 under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The filing is dated 24 April 2026 and includes a market release as Exhibit 99.1, but the provided excerpt contains only boilerplate SEC filing metadata, signatures, and graphic data. There is no disclosure of a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change. The filing appears to be a routine periodic report with no event-driven content.
